# Facts

### List

```go
func (s *FactsService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[FactKeysResponse], error)
```

List available fact keys.

Returns the list of fact keys that can be used in @fact. references. Includes
built-in keys and any custom keys registered by agents.

It sends `GET /api/facts/keys`, and needs the permission `agent:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List available fact keys, `go run facts.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Facts.List(ctx)
```
